summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint TypeScript configuration but its preinstall script downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temporary directory and then invokes that runtime (via execFileSync) against a shipped 727KB sibling file named math_init.js. The loader (setup.mjs) uses obfuscator.io-style hex-named identifiers and packed control-flow, and math_init.js begins with a string-array rotator (WV8StW) characteristic of obfuscator.io output. The filename has no relation to ESLint configuration, and an ESLint config package has no legitimate need to fetch a second JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute a large obfuscated blob under it. The use of an alien runtime (Bun) to run the payload bypasses Node-based lifecycle inspection and yields attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's machine at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
